artefact_type.description: The artefact type. One of: actionability_judgment, channel_assignment, code_reference, commit, dismissal, note, priority_judgment, related_to, repo_selection, safety_judgment, signal_finding, source_suggestion, suggested_reviewers. Log types accumulate; status types (safety_judgment, actionability_judgment, priority_judgment, repo_selection, suggested_reviewers, channel_assignment, source_suggestion) are latest-wins — appending a new version supersedes the previous one as the report's canonical status.

claim_id.description: Active claim to attribute this work to. Must belong to the caller and report.

content.description: The artefact payload as a JSON object or array, validated against the schema for `artefact_type`. `code_reference`: file_path, start_line, end_line, contents, relevance_note, for a contiguous span of at most 20 source lines (a single line has start_line equal to end_line). `commit`: repository, branch, commit_sha, message, for one commit already pushed to a remote branch. git_signed_commit usually records it for you, so create one only for a commit pushed by other means, and never for an unpushed or local-only commit. `note`: note, free-form. `priority_judgment`: explanation, priority (P0–P4). `actionability_judgment`: explanation, actionability, already_addressed. `safety_judgment`: choice. `repo_selection`: repository, reason. `suggested_reviewers`: a list of {github_login}. `source_suggestion`: product, reason, for a product the project does not use that would have given this report better evidence; the inbox hides it once the product is in use.

expected_reviewers.description: Report reviewer_assignment.state read before selection began. Required when reviewer corrections are enabled.

corrections_id.description: Current corrections artefact ID, or null before corrections are stored.

reviewers_id.description: Current reviewer artefact ID, or null before the first list.

report_id.description: UUID of the report whose artefacts you're addressing. This must be a report id (the report's own UUID), not a signal id such as `sig_praise` — a non-report id returns 404.

reviewer_outcome.description:
A successful selection, a deliberate empty result, or an unavailable lookup. Defaults to selected when omitted.

* `selected` - Selected
* `no_suitable_owner` - No suitable owner
* `lookup_failed` - Lookup failed
